links.outcome: Risk prediction accuracy of AgentMD compared with GPT-4 baseline
links.effect: AgentMD outperformed GPT-4 for risk prediction, 87.7% vs. 40.9% accuracy.
links.quote: Our evaluations show that AgentMD significantly outperforms GPT-4 for risk prediction (87.7% vs. 40.9% in accuracy).

unlisted_practices: Automated curation and unit-test quality checks of LLM-generated executable clinical calculators
Tool-learning agent that selects and applies clinical calculators

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates a novel LLM-based agent system (AgentMD) for curating and using clinical calculators on retrospective notes. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
